text: Gratitude is a light that turns whatever it touches into blessing.
The heart that thanks Allah in ease is the heart that finds Him in hardship.
A grateful heart is a happy heart, and a happy heart draws more blessings to it.
Patience is bitter to taste, but what grows from it is sweeter than honey.
When the heart weeps for what it has lost, the soul smiles for what it has found.
Do not grieve. Whatever is meant for you will reach you, even if it is beneath two mountains. Whatever is not meant for you will not reach you, even if it is between your two lips.
The soul is like a bird that has lost its way; it will find rest only in remembrance of Allah.
Whoever relies on Allah is never disgraced, and whoever seeks refuge in Him is never defeated.
Contentment is a treasure that never runs out.
Sincerity is a light that Allah casts into the heart of whomever He wills.
